planets.name: K2-325 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-325 with a 6.93-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: K2-325 b was found in 2020 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-325. Its orbit and size follow Castro González et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
